scope: 7 complete supplied 5s RAW files, 791174 bars, both directional 30s execution

stages.output: Complete original JSON, .stable.json, timing telemetry per RAW in GoldenBaseline ZIP; SHA256 per file in inputs.json.
stages.caveat: ZIP full payload in account Library, not in this repository tree.

stages.notes: Decimal/time formatting optimization; indexed OrderAudit and E reconciliation; E parent-stop dedup and selection allocation reductions. Timing one unpaired run per dataset.
Shared strictly pure parent-stop results among non-Live same-direction E passes. No performance guarantee.
Shared pure cross_order and canonical stop caches; reuse validated OrderAudit index. No significant consistent million-bar improvement; V8.1 remains performance reference.

limits: One unpaired complete run per version/file does not determine statistically stable performance.
Exact stable JSON excludes numeric timings only; its schema is checked separately.
Selected internal E and Live tests do not prove every hidden state or callback scenario.
RSS and CPU figures are sampled; peak RSS is a lower bound.
Original RAW 5m file explicitly retired by user and excluded from active suite.
